## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; market shows mixed internals with narrow leadership — Top 5 concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow, 4/5 Technology) and multiple large-cap divergences, confirming a neutral, non-committal backdrop.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +7.75%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +20.73%) ABOVE TREND. Communication showing strength via NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND. Technology mixed leaders include PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND and F (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Consumer Staples show pockets of weakness; mega-cap Tech divergence with NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -10.18%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +20.81% | 1M: -13.14%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.44% | 1M: -3.26%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +10.18% | 1M: -11.80%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -14.11% | 1M: -14.11%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -4.24%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in semiconductors and select consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +25.19%), INTU (1W: +20.81%), PLTR (1W: +14.27%), NOW (1W: +10.44%), PANW (1W: +10.18%). Note major divergence across large caps (MSFT, AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, AMD) — MAJOR divergence present; tactically watch for trend break rather than assuming continuation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/internal rotation: NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.08% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +3.84% | 1M: -5.91%) RECOVERY. Technology: 13/24 positive (Internal Rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft with selective strength: JPM (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -1.84%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +4.43% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +5.29% | 1M: -2.69%) RECOVERY. Financials: 5/20 positive (Sector Weakness).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed but constructive on large caps: UNH (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +9.16%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -2.67%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare: 10/17 positive (Internal Rotation).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy names and select Communications exposure while reducing exposure to cyclical semiconductors and beaten-up retail names; be selective in Technology given narrow leadership and major large-cap divergences. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +20.73%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -14.11% | 1M: -14.11%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (8/10 positive) — Sector Strength; Real Estate (7/10 positive) — Sector Strength. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (3/14 positive) — Sector Weakness; Materials (3/11 positive) — Sector Weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: failure to reclaim the prior 1M downtrend would confirm continued BELOW TREND pressure; AAPL: hold the 1M support to avoid deeper CORRECTION; UNH: sustaining ABOVE TREND momentum would signal further upside continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMD (+60): Advanced Micro Devices — news-tone positive on MI450 ramp yet AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) is BELOW TREND, so sentiment is diverging from price. PG (+80): strong payout plan (news); price action not provided in detail in this dataset for dual timeframe cross-ref — monitor for confirmation. DE (+55): stronger guidance headline; sector-level strength in Industrials should be watched for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-45): leadership shift headline and UNH (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment is somewhat diverging from price and warrants watching for execution risk. CVS (-50): regulatory headline while CVS (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +8.01%) ABOVE TREND — distribution risk if headlines persist. GS (-40): headline risk with unclear price confirmation in dataset — monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). Energy and select Communications/Healthcare names are showing relative strength (XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND, NFLX ABOVE TREND; UNH ABOVE TREND). Key risk is major divergence among mega-cap Techs and semiconductors (NVDA, AMD, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and several bullish headlines that are not yet confirmed by price.
